name: statistics-skill-creator
title_zh: 访谈你一次，生成一个带R脚本的统计检验Skill文件
tagline_zh: 不用从零写SKILL.md、references和scripts。你描述要做的检验，它按模板逐节追问。
tagline_en: Skip the blank-page grind. Describe the test you need; it interviews you section by section, then outputs a Skill.
desc_en: Interviews the user and builds a brand-new statistics-analysis SKILL folder (SKILL.md, references/, scripts/) by filling in the template at references/skill-procedure.md section by section with details specific to the statistical test or procedure requested. The created SKILL validates inputs, checks assumptions, runs the authoritative R computation, and writes a stakeholder-ready report. Trigger
why_zh: 把统计方法论的隐性决策（假设检验、效应量、报告口径）变成显式追问，而不是让你对着空模板发呆。
why_en: Turns hidden statistical decisions—assumption checks, effect sizes, reporting conventions—into explicit prompts, instead of.
limit_zh: 只生成统计检验/流程类Skill，不写数据清洗或可视化。需要本机装R和必要包；产出的是文件夹骨架和脚本。
limit_en: Only builds stats-test/procedure Skills—no data cleaning or viz. Requires local R + packages. Outputs folder skeleton & scripts, not validated on.
title_en: Interview once, generate a stats-test Skill folder with R.
